name: billing_watch
description: Runs automatically once a day to check Anthropic API spend via the Admin Cost Report API and report it. Also usable on request ("how much have I spent on Claude", "check my API billing").
instructions: Use run_python to call the Anthropic Admin Cost Report API directly (this is a plain metadata GET, not a Messages API call, and costs nothing to call). Read the admin key from the ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_API_KEY environment variable in that Python code - never print, log, or repeat the key value itself anywhere, including in your spoken reply. Send a GET request to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/organizations/cost_report with headers {'x-api-key': <the env var value>, 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01'}, and query params starting_at/ending_at covering roughly the last 24-48 hours (ISO 8601 UTC, e.g. starting_at=<yesterday>T00:00:00Z&ending_at=<today>T00:00:00Z) plus group_by[]=description. Sum the cost items (amounts are decimal strings in USD) to get a total for the period. If the ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_API_KEY environment variable is empty or the request fails (e.g. 401/403), say briefly that billing monitoring isn't set up yet (an Admin API key needs to be created in the Claude Console and added to .env) rather than treating it as a real error. On success, call remember_fact (category="fact") with a one-line record like "Billing check <date>: $<total> spent in the last 24h" so there's a persisted spend history, then give a short spoken summary of the amount as your final reply.
